title: ceramic coffee mug
request: A ceramic coffee mug with a thick, chunky handle. Outside glaze: dark blue (deep navy, e.g. around #1F2E5A), glossy ceramic. Inside glaze: white (#F4F2EE), glossy ceramic. Purpose: render. Size: 10 cm tall (set on the page). Defaults chosen: classic straight-sided cylindrical mug, outer diameter about 8.5 cm, wall thickness about 4-5 mm, slightly rounded lip, a small unglazed or slightly recessed foot ring at the base, about 330 ml capacity. Thick C-shaped handle (cross-section roughly 1.4 x 1.0 cm with rounded edges), large enough for 2-3 fingers, attached smoothly to the side with soft fillets where it meets the body. The white inside glaze should wrap over the lip and meet the blue just below the rim edge on the outside with a clean line. No logos or text. Realistic product render on a plain light neutral background, soft studio lighting, three-quarter view showing the handle and a little of the white interior. Budget set on page: 4 USD. Note from earlier projects: verify the exported file reflects the latest scene edits (check material colours and object names after re-export).
